thread:
tess: Quick thread — visibility mismatch report from support: proxied requests all show the proxy key in console, customers want project-level provenance but dashboards spike.
noah: We can't change enforcement path. Billing uses the auth-resolver canonical counter (post-exchange). But visibility can be better without huge cardinality.
li: Proposed playbook: 1) Emit lightweight provenance records only for sampled requests. Each record includes origin_key_id, a compact eff_identity_hash, route_id, model, region. 2) Use per-key reservoir sampler: keep up to K events/day for low-volume keys, then downsample hot keys to p%.
tess: That sounds fine. We need clear guarantees: at-least-K/day per key and global avg sampling <1% for cost SLO.
noah: Implementation note: compute eff_identity_hash = hex(HMAC_SHA256(eff_identity, telemetry-secret))[0:10] so we never store raw customer IDs. Store the hash and a small TTL index of hot hashes.
li: Also add an opt-in console toggle per-org: "Show delegated identity details (may incur extra billing/index costs)" default off. When off, the UI still shows sampled provenance counts but not the eff_identity_hash values.
tess: UX should include an explainer: "Console metrics are sampled for cost reasons; use billing exports for authoritative usage." Put that in the key/activity header.
noah: Rollout: stage A (staging) sampler + eff_hash for top 8k keys, retention 30d. stage B expand to 25k, add 90d retention for keys flagged under investigation.
li: Ops safety: sampled pipeline will be read-only for quota math. Add a test that fails if sampled telemetry is referenced by the enforcer.
ops-bot: deploy started: telemetry-provenance-sampler@staging -> v0.4.2 by ci/cd at 2026-03-23T09:15:03Z
tess: Action items: li PR for sampler + eff_hash lib by Tue, noah mock console toggle + tooltip, I'll draft rollout doc and cost estimate for billing. We'll reconvene after staging metrics.
